areas.t: Expect diurnal fluctuations of fine particles Wednesday and Thursday.  The greatest hourly concentrations will be around or just after the morning rush hour as well as after sunset when wood burning is present.  With high pressure in control throughout the week, winds remain light and variable, allo

Current Conditions: The northeasterly winds earlier in the day have allowed fine particulates (PM2.5) to stay in the good range especially in the morning. The weak southerly flow will start later today and the increase in humidity will keep PM2.5 in the low-moderate range the remainder of the day. *
